body_markdown:
ARLINGTON, Va., Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Privia Health Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: PRVA) announced the acquisition of American Choice Healthcare MSSP, LLC (ACH), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Cano Health. The Accountable Care Organization (ACO) will care for more than 36,000 attributed lives in the Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) starting January 1, 2027.


Privia Health paid approximately $36 million at closing using cash on its balance sheet. The transaction is expected to have minimal impact on all key metrics in 2026 and will positively contribute to Attributed Lives and Adjusted EBITDA in 2027.


This strategic transaction further scales Privia Care Partners, adding attributed lives in both existing and new states, and also offers a compelling synergy opportunity for providers to join Privia’s Medical Groups for a full suite of services and technology platform.


“Adding ACH to our national network of ACOs underscores Privia Health’s ability to replicate our differentiated and flexible operating model with new practice partners across the country,” said Sam Starbuck, Senior Vice President and President, Privia Care Partners. “We look forward to collaborating with these physicians and their practices, leveraging our population health and value-based care expertise to enhance the patient experience, improve outcomes, and lower costs.”


**About Privia Health**


Privia Health™ is one of the largest physician enablement companies in the United States with a presence in 25 states and the District of Columbia. Privia builds scaled provider networks with primary-care centric medical groups, risk-bearing entities, a physician-led governance structure, and the Privia Platform comprising an extensive suite of technology and service solutions. Privia collaborates with medical groups, health plans and health systems to optimize 1,300+ physician practices, improve the patient experience for 6.1+ million patients, and reward 5,600+ physicians and advanced practitioners for delivering high-value care.


Privia’s mission is to transform healthcare delivery to achieve better outcomes, lower costs, and improve the health of communities and the well-being of providers. For more information, visit[priviahealth.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=_TAeUFXBE-8lqFchO88NyAEmqwQPx42NChtc3sNzRQW71x7mQB0BwfoRe8N0fBqTeQ3j8NgiBe-yn9l0R0AH5DAI3OFioi72_gv37P6pCGA=) .
